Systematic Financial Management Lp decreased its stake in Meredith Corp. (MDP) by 24.49% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Systematic Financial Management Lp sold 89,439 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.23% with the market. The institutional investor held 275,772 shares of the newspapers and magazines company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.22M, down from 365,211 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Systematic Financial Management Lp who had been investing in Meredith Corp. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.23B market cap company. The stock increased 0.61% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $49.4. About 563,421 shares traded. Meredith Corporation (NYSE:MDP) has declined 14.74% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.29% the S&P500.
